source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The website looks great overall! I only found a few remaining items: could the portfolio tiles on the home page link to the gallery, and could the indicated stock photos be replaced with the supplied photos? I’d also like the home-page image changed to a photo of a house. Apart from those requests, everything is looking good. Thank you!

source_message.speaker: agency
source_message.text:
Priya,

I hope you’re doing well. Based on your feedback, the website has now been updated.

Please review the latest version and share your thoughts with us.

Thank you! 🙂

execution.observed_behavior: The agency reports completing the bounded set of requested website updates, including linking the homepage portfolio tiles to the Gallery page.

routing_warnings.description: The request for homepage buttons to link to the Gallery, Pricing, and Services pages concerns section navigation buttons, not the homepage portfolio tiles.
The implementation claim concerns homepage section buttons leading to their respective pages, not the portfolio-tile link.
